Conjugacy Classes of Hyperbolic Matrices in Sl(n, Z) and Ideal Classes in an Order

Article

  * May 1984

Transactions of the American Mathematical Society

  * Dorothy I. Wallace

A bijection is proved between Sl(n, Z)-conjugacy classes of hyperbolic matrices with eigenvalues {λ1,...,λn} which are units in an n-degree number field, and narrow ideal classes of the ring Rk = Z[ λi ]. A bijection between Gl(n, Z)-conjugacy classes and the wide ideal classes, which had been known, is repeated with a different proof.
